issues.snippet: throw new UnsupportedOperationException("ObjectInputStream is insecure. Use JSON serialization instead.");
issues.description: Java deserialization of untrusted data can lead to remote code execution via gadget chains.
issues.fix: Avoid ObjectInputStream with untrusted data. Use look-ahead deserialization or JSON-based formats.

issues.description: A private key is committed to the codebase. It can impersonate servers, decrypt data, or sign malicious artifacts.
issues.fix: Remove the key immediately. Rotate it. Store keys outside the repo using a secrets manager.

issues.snippet: # Keys should be stored in a secure key management system (e.g., AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault)
issues.description: PHP shell execution function detected. If user input reaches these, it enables remote code execution.
issues.fix: Avoid shell functions. Use escapeshellarg() and escapeshellcmd() if absolutely needed. Validate all input.

issues.snippet: // FIX: Removed eval() usage completely, use safe alternative or just a placeholder
issues.description: eval() executes arbitrary code. Untrusted input passed to eval leads to Remote Code Execution.
issues.fix: Avoid eval(). Use JSON.parse() for data. In Python, use ast.literal_eval() for safe evaluation.

issues.description: Hardcoded IP reduces flexibility and may expose internal network topology.
issues.fix: Use environment variables, DNS hostnames, or service discovery.

issues.description: Console statements can leak internal data to browser dev tools or server logs in production.
issues.fix: Remove console.log before deployment. Use a proper logging library with log levels.
